# contrastRatio

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio between two sRGB colours, in `[1, 21]`. Order-independent: the lighter colour is always the numerator.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
contrastRatio(a: [number, number, number], b: [number, number, number]): number
```
